notes.title: 🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.04 Update is Live! 🕵️‍♂️
notes.notes:
[h1]🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.04 Update is Live![/h1][p][/p][h3]Exciting new features, refined gameplay mechanics, and a brand-new Prologue await you jump into your island trading adventure anew![/h3][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]✨ Brand New UI Overhaul[/h3][list][*][p][b]Complete UI Redesign:[/b] Every interface has been beautifully redesigned for clarity, ease-of-use, and smooth visual transitions. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/0b63ebcb2c23f953046db3fdbb1565b1540e4a51.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Smooth Scrolling:[/b] No more harsh scrolling menus and inventories glide seamlessly for a comfortable browsing experience. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/78715e15b174a8fea62c0f15b90342b5a0a0cee5.png"][/img]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🕵️‍♂️ Watch Out! Thieves on the Island![/h3][list][*][p][b]New Thief Mechanic:[/b] Keep a close eye on your market sneaky thieves 🦹‍♂️ will occasionally attempt to steal your goods! [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/894266f731a5475fd15ce97fc155b21717283dfe.png"][/img]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🗑️ Keep Your Island Clean![/h3][list][*][p][b]Waste Management System:[/b] Customers now leave litter behind. Regularly tidy up to maintain a clean, attractive island for your visitors.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/09d7a7c1d72da50a78dd2f62e119b9a6d4fa773a.png"][/img]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]⚒️ Workshop System Unlocked![/h3][list][*][p][b]Craft Unique Products:[/b] Combine items to create exciting new products! Start crafting with the Alcohol Distillery 🍾 and Oven 🥖! [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/93143dc17a6ecc6f35d59fea2ead2f21dcdc2383.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Engineer’s Shop Now Open:[/b] Visit the engineer’s building to buy essential workshop equipment. [/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/084ba496a57aadb5ebf8a4cbc070078a809efc77.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]💾 Major Save System Update[/h3][list][*][p][b]Save System Redesigned:[/b] We've drastically improved save/load times for better gameplay. [/p][/*][*][p]⚠️ [b]Important:[/b] All previous saves have been reset due to this upgrade. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but starting fresh will greatly enhance your experience! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🎬 New Prologue & Tutorial Videos[/h3][list][*][p][b]Playable Prologue:[/b] Experience a short story-driven introduction, perfect for learning game mechanics. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/0250d5370bb9b1ee63fe6bd3b1984d1430b062c7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Enhanced Tutorials:[/b] Quick, clear tutorial videos now accompany new game starts to ensure you dive right into the action.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/8469a4b2e50f78af257cdfa8e2c8f470ac3add24.png"][/img]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]Developer’s Secret Message[/b][/h2][p][i]“Stay tuned—our next update will bring even more immersive features and additional languages!”[/i]

[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.3 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1]🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.3 Update is Here![/h1][h3]We’ve packed this release with clarity, quality-of-life improvements, and fresh content to deepen your island trading experience![/h3][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]📚 Revamped Tutorial & UI[/h3][list][*][p][b]Complete tutorial overhaul:[/b] Every step is now crystal clear, guiding you through planting, harvesting, and trading with on-screen tips and highlights.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Intuitive button states:[/b] UI elements instantly show active vs. inactive functions—no more guessing which action you’re about to take.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/99c2f64b8fac48cb0d2f2f956f5605a65d70c062.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🥛 Crate Management & Item Details[/h3][list][*][p][b]Dedicated milk crates:[/b] Milk collection crates and empty product crates can now be distinguished.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/46c61c141e827766ad9ee89383f1bbb1ecdbe8cd.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Seed-to-crop tooltips:[/b] Hover over any seed to see exactly which crop it grows into and how long it will take.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/85fe8c5f86649d15b4dd94a8b3475da64e427aa6.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Rich item HUD:[/b] View an item’s name, type, and remaining durability or uses while holding it—no need to open menus.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/230d08a8c54e05df5ddf5e4a1c0356f73fd689d9.png"][/img]
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]💰 Economy & NPC Overhaul[/h3][list][*][p][b]Auto-pricing system:[/b] When you list goods for sale, suggested prices are assigned automatically—just confirm and trade![/p][p] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Three NPC tiers:[/b] Rich, Middle-Class, and Poor visitors now have unique names, preferences, and price-acceptance thresholds for a more dynamic market.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/f0334e346ae3594ad09a828829a0ea9a1453478f.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Friendly skeleton aide:[/b] If your funds drop to zero, sleep peacefully for two days and a helpful skeleton will appear to lend you a hand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/2a8bee1126c6be561b712c7d65c95b7a0e61934f.png"][/img]   [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🚧 Map Collision & Animation Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smooth map traversal:[/b] All collision glitches have been fixed so you can explore beaches and groves without ever getting stuck. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster rotation controls:[/b] Shelves, displays, and other placeable objects now rotate more quickly, making setup a breeze. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Satisfying placement animation:[/b] A new spin-and-snap effect adds polish every time you position items. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Safety confirmations:[/b] “Are you sure you want to sleep?” and faction-selection dialogs prevent accidental choices while navigating menus.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]🗓️ Calendar & Wayfinding Upgrades[/h3][list][*][p][b]Detailed calendar view:[/b] Track day counters, seasonal events, and special festivals right in the pause menu—plan your harvests and sales with confidence.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543285/e7b918c9c0709435944e630df1b8a69c18a4d3a8.png"][/img] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved navigation markers:[/b] Clear signposts and map pins make finding your home, storage, and key stalls effortless. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced NPC animations:[/b] Watch buyers browse stalls and wait in line with updated, lifelike movements that bring the market to life. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Developer’s Secret Message[/b] [/h2][p][b][i]“Coming soon in the v0.5 update: we’ll be available in 11 different languages for our valued players—stay tuned!”[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Dive back into Island Market Simulator v0.3 and discover a richer, smoother, and more strategic trading adventure! 🌟[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.2 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]🏝️ Island Market Simulator v0.2 Update is Here![/b][/h1][h3]We’re taking a big step forward just before [b]Next Fest[/b]! With the v0.2 update, Island Market Simulator now offers a much deeper and more strategic gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/56e1c2d09a052502fdb643dc90d9653ad58de6c5.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📅 Calendar System Added[/h3][p]A brand new [b]calendar[/b] is now part of the game! Players can check upcoming [b]seasonal and historical events[/b], plan their [b]product strategies[/b], and manage their [b]stock[/b] accordingly. Is a festival coming up? Expect a demand spike—be prepared![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/d33b8aecd318d8d33d3efa2b45ac7f9e82534040.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🏠 Rent and Profit Balancing[/h3][list][*][p][b]Rent prices have been adjusted[/b], offering a more realistic economic progression as you expand your store.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]profit margins[/b] of products like [b]blackberries, milk, and currants[/b] have been [b]significantly increased[/b]. Selling the right item at the right time is now even more rewarding![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/e2d6d2a8ffbf11e1e960a1062e6c3a95267ff4f6.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📘 Improved Tutorial and Map Enhancements[/h3][p]We’ve made it easier for new players to dive in:[/p][list][*][p]The tutorial has been [b]completely revamped[/b] to provide a smoother onboarding experience.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]map has been added to the pause menu[/b], and [b]signposts[/b] are now placed around key locations to make exploration more intuitive.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/4a2eb7c560d1e2f273b75fea3adf14c9797d5799.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/aeae9888ea6f4766d9e65eeda3466cde35c0be81.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧭 More Quest Variety[/h3][p]A wider range of quests is now available, bringing more diverse challenges and stories as you progress in your journey.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45543285/6632e6509ac612b1944cd165b44344b244408a2d.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌟 Market Reputation Matters More[/h3][p]Your store’s [b]reputation[/b] now has a [b]direct and significant impact on customer demand[/b]. A well-respected market attracts more customers and drives more sales![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]With this update, Island Market Simulator offers a richer, more immersive experience full of strategic depth.
[b]See you at Next Fest! 🎉[/b][/p]
